periods.time: Tokyo underground defense and victory night
periods.label: 防卫层与误认小一辉

status.current: survives the underground defense and returns to celebration
status.condition: injured in the defense layer but rescued by reinforcements

relationships.kaito-ayatsuji: Father; he unexpectedly fights beside her and saves her from EDY fire.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Rival/complicated ally; his return saves the defense layer and he shows awkward concern for her injury.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Mistakes his child body for an injured boy and drags him to a women's bath, not believing he is Ikki.

periods.summary: Ayase leads frightened low-rank students in the underground defense layer after EDY breaches Tokyo's shelter zone. Her own sword cannot damage EDY armor, but she keeps fighting and is joined by her father Kaito. When she is injured and about to be shot, Kaito kicks her away and Kuraudo arrives to crush the EDY. On victory night Ayase finds miniature Ikki covered in blood, assumes he is a lost child, and takes him to a public bath; because the men's side is full, she unwittingly brings him into the women's side and later does not believe his claim to be the real Ikki.

key_events.summary: Fights EDY in the underground city until Kaito, Kuraudo, Moroboshi and Toka's group turn the battle.
Mistakes child-sized Ikki for a boy and takes him to bathe.
